market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI hit intraday highs of $110+ today (Apr 30). Question is $115 HIGH by end of June. Just $5-7 higher than current spike level. With Iran tensions persistent and 2 months runway, a $115 print is likely - oil already toying with these levels. ~0.65-0.75 range.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether tensions ease enough that we don't see another rally leg - but $115 only needs one geopolitical headline.
